title: Mordheim KB catalogue — catalog/hirelings/traits.yaml
description: The trait registry of the hireling catalogue: the race, alignment, nature and ability facts the hiring eligibility rules reason about, declared once here and read by the application through `KnowledgePort.hireling_traits()` instead of being curated inside the application. Each row pins the profile it describes and lists its traits; `tests/python/knowledge/test_campaign_catalogs.py` checks that every `profile_id` exists in the hireling catalogues.

traits.description: One row per profile that declares traits. A profile without traits has no row.

profile_traits.description: The traits of one hireling profile.

traits.description: The facts the hiring rules evaluate. The vocabulary is closed: a new trait is a new ability the eligibility rules may reason about, so it is added here and to the application together.
